ledger_events.side: its lowest side (0 bid / 1 ask of the Up book)

ledger_events.S2_hi: S2 window (measured envelopes AND the REST cap): the same fields as S1_
ledger_events.cls: evidence class 0 WS / 1 E2 / 2 imputed / 3 mixed

ledger_legs.t_ms: WS settlementsPending source time linked by value (no signed identity), venue_ms
ledger_legs.exec_s: REST executedAt second = the Confirmed status, venue clock s (an upper bound on the match)
ledger_legs.row_id: its legs_timed2 row (stable identity with the file hash)
ledger_legs.first_recv_ns: first receipt of the REST leg, local_ns
ledger_legs.tk_status: pf_txmap status 0 mapped / 1 absent / 2 count mismatch / 3 ambiguous / 4 no taker hash / 5 refined by signer

ledger_fills.t_replay: the replay M50 fill time, replay_ms
ledger_fills.src: the replay source code 0 WS / 1 E2 / 2 imputed / 3 mixed
ledger_fills.pulled: the declared score executed a pull on its order
ledger_fills.landing37: the score pull landing at 37 ms, replay_ms
ledger_fills.replay_removed: removed by the pull in the replay
ledger_fills.event: its event index if unique, else -1
ledger_fills.notice_assumed: the replay own-fill notice delay (configured point), ms
ledger_fills.contra_S1: per-fill status over ALL its candidate events (CST): S1 / S2 contradicted, replay time after the evidence cap
ledger_fills.contra_S2: per-fill status over ALL its candidate events (CST): S1 / S2 contradicted, replay time after the evidence cap
ledger_fills.contra_after_evidence: per-fill status over ALL its candidate events (CST): S1 / S2 contradicted, replay time after the evidence cap
ledger_fills.cls_S1_CP: ordering class (ORD) per scenario and cancel window (CP / CR), -1 not pulled
ledger_fills.cls_S1_CR: ordering class (ORD) per scenario and cancel window (CP / CR), -1 not pulled
ledger_fills.cls_S2_CP: ordering class (ORD) per scenario and cancel window (CP / CR), -1 not pulled
ledger_fills.cls_S2_CR: ordering class (ORD) per scenario and cancel window (CP / CR), -1 not pulled
ledger_fills.cls_EV_CP: ordering class (ORD) per scenario and cancel window (CP / CR), -1 not pulled
ledger_fills.cls_EV_CR: ordering class (ORD) per scenario and cancel window (CP / CR), -1 not pulled

ledger_orders.m50_value: its M50 fill value at END, c
ledger_orders.decision_S1: decision evaluability per scenario: not_pulled / no_m50_fill / evaluable / not_evaluable / not_eligible
ledger_orders.decision_S2: decision evaluability per scenario: not_pulled / no_m50_fill / evaluable / not_evaluable / not_eligible
ledger_orders.decision_EV: decision evaluability per scenario: not_pulled / no_m50_fill / evaluable / not_evaluable / not_eligible

S1|WS: latest WS pending source time over the legs - 250 ms
earliest WS pending source time over the legs
S1|E2: latest E2 book-drop estimate over the legs - 250 ms
earliest E2 book-drop estimate over the legs + 250 ms
S1|imputed: latest REST second over the legs - 500 ms (status-centred assumption)
earliest REST second over the legs + 500 ms (status-centred assumption)
S1|mixed: the latest start of its WS and E2 legs' windows
the earliest end of its WS and E2 legs' windows
S2|WS: latest WS pending source time over the legs - h
earliest WS pending source time over the legs + h
S2|E2: latest E2 book-drop estimate over the legs - h
earliest E2 book-drop estimate over the legs + h
S2|imputed: latest REST second over the legs + q01 (status-centred assumption)
earliest REST second over the legs + q99 (status-centred assumption)
S2|mixed: the latest start of its WS and E2 legs' windows
the earliest end of its WS and E2 legs' windows

cap_basis: REST executedAt (the Confirmed status) second end, earliest over the legs
rep_rule: M50: the replay anchor - 50 ms (the replay assumption, not a match time)

clocks.venue_ms: REST executedAt, WS settlementsPending source and book frame times: venue clocks, ms; their mutual alignment is NOT established
clocks.local_ns: first_recv_ns: the collector local receipt clock, ns; not aligned to the venue clocks
clocks.replay_ms: ms after the order posting time t0 on the venue axis (the replay axis)
